test_title: PYST 31: SSC GD Constable 2025 - English (Held On: 19 Feb, 2025 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the bracketed word to fill in the blank.

No child should be exposed to violence, abuse or ______________________ (neglect).
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 (attend)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"neglect"** means to fail to care for properly or to pay proper attention to something or someone. (उपेक्षा करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The parents were charged for neglecting their child's basic needs.
 
 
 
• **"Attend"** refers to taking care of or giving attention to someone or something. (देखभाल करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The nurse attended to the patient's injuries with great care.
 
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of "neglect" is **"attend."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 (attend)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Appear** (प्रकट होना): To become visible or noticeable.

 
 
• **Example:** She appeared nervous during the interview.
 
 
 
• **Feel** (महसूस करना): To experience a sensation or emotion.
 
 
• **Example:** I feel happy when I spend time with my family.
 
 
 
• **Forgive** (माफ करना): To stop feeling angry or resentful towards someone for a mistake or offense.
 
 
• **Example:** She decided to forgive her friend for the misunderstanding.
